tasks.gr12-final-nsc-paper-strategy-t4: Topic: Grade 12 English HL final NSC paper strategy. Cover Paper 1, Paper 2 and Paper 3 routines, timing, exam planning, summary and writing strategies, and switching between paper demands. Ask learners to identify best time-management choices, match strategies to papers, choose suitable revision actions and avoid common final-exam mistakes.
tasks.gr12-literature-consolidation-t4: Topic: Grade 12 English HL literature consolidation. Cover drama, novel, poetry, quotation recall, theme linkage, unseen responses and short revision sets. Ask learners to connect quotations to themes, distinguish effective revision techniques, interpret unseen passages and explain how literature knowledge can be condensed for final revision.
tasks.gr12-writing-recall-proofreading-t4: Topic: Grade 12 English HL writing recall and proofreading. Cover essay planning, transactional format recall, editing checklists, proofreading routines, tone control and audience awareness. Ask learners to identify format conventions, choose effective proofreading steps, correct tone errors and select the most suitable writing structure for exam-style prompts.
